prompt:
1. Everytime you finish a task: Use the `append` action of the `git_changelog_manager` tool to register your latest changes into the branch changelog.
2. Do never read the changelog (`read` action) until you going to push the changes to the remote repository.
3. When you're going to push the local project changes to the remote repository, read the whole changelog, summarize it and use the resume as the argument for the command `git commit -m`.
description: The first version of Git Changelog Manager.

tools.name: git_changelog_manager
tools.title: Git Changelog Manager
tools.description: Allows the LLM to write logs into a changelog related with the current branch.

text.description: The text to write or append into the changelog. Required if `action` is `append` or `write`.

oneOf.title: Append into changelog
oneOf.description: Inserts a new line into the changelog.

oneOf.title: Write changelog
oneOf.description: Replaces the whole content of the changelog.

context.name: Git Changelog
context.description: It allows the LLM to register summaries of code updates to publish them in the pull request summary.
